caption:
Holiday group chat, translated: four phrases and what they really mean.
Save it for the next “who’s bringing what?”
Link in bio.
by NMR

alt.1: Video with our own music, 6 seconds, slow push-in on the cover. Cella next to a big phone with a group chat. Save · 4 translations. Holiday group chat, translated. 4 phrases and what they really mean.
alt.2: split in two colors: what you say on top, what it means below. What you say: “Who's bringing what?” What it means: Nobody. It's you.
alt.3: split in two colors: what you say on top, what it means below. What you say: “I'll be there around 4.” What it means: 6:40. With excuses.
alt.4: split in two colors: what you say on top, what it means below. What you say: “Don't bring anything.” What it means: Bring something.
alt.5: split in two colors: what you say on top, what it means below. What you say: “We're keeping it small.” What it means: 31 people.
alt.6: four phrases as a list. The cheat sheet. The group chat, decoded: Send it to whoever runs the holiday chat. 1. Who's bringing: you 2. Around 4: 6:40 3. Bring nothing: bring something 4. Small: 31 people.
